thread.title: Apple price target raised to $214 at Morgan Stanley on optimism about services business - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple price target raised to $214 at Morgan Stanley on optimism about services business - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.49% are little changed in Thursday trading after Morgan Stanley analyst Katy Huberty raised her price target on the stock to $214 from $200 on optimism for the company's services business. "We've increasingly heard from investors that the fastest growing but lowest margin businesses within Apple Services, such as Apple Music, iCloud, and Apple Pay, will drive negative mix shift away from higher margin, more established businesses like the the App Store, such that Services margins are close to peak levels," Huberty wrote. "We disagree." She argued that the App Store is growing off of a large, $12 billion revenue base, which should enable it to contribute "the largest portion of incremental revenue growth going forward." Apple shares are up 23% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.68% has gained 18%.
